title_en: Additional Night Library Shuttle Buses and Late-Night Shuttle Route Change During Examination Periods
summary: During the examination periods, one additional bus will run on the Administration Building to Seoul National University Station night library shuttle route. The late-night shuttle will run on a new timetable and a revised route that adds the Open-Air Auditorium stop.

translation:
Title: Additional Night Library Shuttle Buses and Late-Night Shuttle Route Change During Examination Periods

During the examination periods, additional buses will be added to the night library shuttle route, and the route of the late-night shuttle will be changed. The shuttles will operate as set out below. Please take note.

○ Operating periods (excluding weekends and public holidays)
- 1st round: 12 October 2026 (Mon) to 30 October 2026 (Fri)
- 2nd round: 30 November 2026 (Mon) to 14 December 2026 (Mon)

○ Night library shuttle: additional bus plan
- Administration Building [행정관] → Seoul National University Station [서울대입구역]: 2 buses before the change; 3 buses after the change.
- Administration Building [행정관] → Daehak-dong [대학동]: 2 buses before the change; 2 buses after the change (no change).
- Operating times: same as at present (21:10, 21:40, 22:10, 22:40, 23:10).

○ Late-night shuttle operating plan

Before the change:
- Departure times (from Building 302 [302동]): 24:00, 00:30, 01:00, 01:30, 02:00
- Number of buses: 1
- Interval: 30 minutes
- Route: Building 302 [302동] – Building 301 [301동] – Institute of New Energy and Resources Technology [에너지자원신기술연구소] – Building 38 [38동] – College of Agriculture and Life Sciences [농생대] – College of Natural Sciences [자연대] – Main Gate [정문] – Business School [경영대] – College of Veterinary Medicine [수의대] – Graduate School of International Studies [국제대학원] – Dormitory [기숙사] – BK International House [BK국제관] – Nakseongdae (Inheon Elementary School) [낙성대(인헌초)] – Seoul National University Station [서울대입구역]

After the change:
- Departure times (from Building 302 [302동]): 23:40, 00:15, 00:50, 01:25, 02:00
- Number of buses: 1
- Interval: 35 minutes
- Route: Building 302 [302동] – Building 301 [301동] – Institute of New Energy and Resources Technology [에너지자원신기술연구소] – Building 38 [38동] – College of Agriculture and Life Sciences [농생대] – College of Natural Sciences [자연대] – Main Gate [정문] – Business School [경영대] – College of Veterinary Medicine [수의대] – Graduate School of International Studies [국제대학원] – Open-Air Auditorium [노천강당] – Dormitory [기숙사] – BK International House [BK국제관] – Nakseongdae (Inheon Elementary School) [낙성대(인헌초)] – Seoul National University Station [서울대입구역]

Note: The Open-Air Auditorium [노천강당] stop has been added to the late-night shuttle route, between the Graduate School of International Studies and the Dormitory.
